label: KuCoin (spot)
terms_note: Public market-data endpoints only (no API key). HTML docs (no OpenAPI link on the pages). Every answer is HTTP 200 {code, data|msg}; success is code "200000". Live 2026-10-01: an unknown symbol on /api/v1/market/stats answers code 200000 with every field null (no error), so the entry fails the call when data.last is null; /api/v1/market/candles answers {"code":"400100","msg":"Unsupported trading pair."}. Candle rows are [time(s), open, CLOSE, HIGH, LOW, volume, turnover], newest first - not the usual OHLC order. Public REST weight limits per IP (see the rate-limit page).

error_kinds.note: stats for an unknown symbol: code 200000 with every field null

list_markets.note: Every spot symbol (BTC-USDT style); paged locally; query is a substring of symbol/base/quote.

get_ticker.note: 24h statistics; volume is the 24h base volume.

get_candles.note: interval: 1m 3m 5m 15m 30m 1h 2h 4h 6h 8h 12h 1d 1w 1M. Newest first; at most 1500 per call; the newest `limit` are returned.

not_offered.me: Account endpoints need KC-API-KEY, an HMAC-SHA256 KC-API-SIGN and an encrypted passphrase; public-data entry only.
not_offered.get_balances: GET /api/v1/accounts needs an API key; public-data entry only.
not_offered.list_orders: GET /api/v1/orders needs an API key; public-data entry only.
not_offered.place_order: POST /api/v1/orders needs an API key and spends money; not mapped.
not_offered.cancel_order: DELETE /api/v1/orders/{orderId} needs an API key; not mapped.
